description: This file is a shell script for testing Git rebase functionalities, including various options and behaviors during rebase operations, such as handling empty commits, merge modes, and interactive modes.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes provided lines to specified files for setup of test repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test that is expected to succeed, verifying Git rebase operations and outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Runs a test that is expected to fail, typically testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the given command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that specific files or paths are missing after operations, indicating cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output, typically logs or commit messages.
